labels.transfer_failed_calls: Super tried to transfer, nobody picked up

definitions.total_calls: Inbound calls from outside phone numbers in Ultatel this week (CALL count). Excludes Super's transfer legs into the office (they belong to a call already counted) and Pollard's own numbers.
definitions.answered_calls: Of those calls, how many were picked up by a person or by Super (CALL count). A call that went straight to voicemail is not counted as answered.
definitions.missed_calls: Calls nobody picked up: rang with no answer, or went straight to voicemail.
definitions.transfer_failed_calls: Calls Super answered and then tried to transfer to the team, where no one picked up (ring group and any fallback collapsed into one attempt; voicemail counts as not picked up). These calls are inside answered_calls, because Super did answer.
definitions.unanswered_callers: Different outside callers (PERSON count) whose call was missed or whose Super transfer went unanswered, and who did not get through on a later call this week (a later call counts only if a person picked up, or Super handled it without a failed transfer).
definitions.called_back: Of the callers we didn't answer, how many got a call from our phones at any time after their last unanswered call, up to the end of the export.
definitions.not_called_back: Of the callers we didn't answer, how many have had no call from our phones since their last unanswered call (through the end of the export). A message Super took doesn't count as a callback.
definitions.never_called: Of the not-called-back callers, how many we never dialed at all during the week (not even before their missed call).
definitions.waiting: For not-called-back callers: time from their last unanswered call to the end of the export.
definitions.reconcile: 473 calls = 393 answered (367 by Super + 26 by staff) + 80 missed (23 rang with no answer + 57 went to voicemail). Of the 367 Super answered, 117 ended in a transfer nobody picked up (75 callers). 103 callers had a missed call or failed transfer; 29 got through later, leaving 74 callers we didn't answer: 22 called back, 52 not called back yet (36 of those never called this week).

excluded.note: Excluded legs are not in total_calls; Super's transfer legs are used only to find failed transfers. Anonymous calls are counted as calls but can't be counted as callers.

summary.source: Ultatel Call Details CSV; callback = any company OUT-Bound to the caller's number. Super open-loop logs used only to break ties when matching transfers. Personal cells, texts, and Super messages are not visible.

super_links.match_rule: phone digits + last missed call (CT) within ±5 minutes

super_transfers_unanswered.attribution_rule: Ultatel has no field linking a transfer leg to the caller's call, so each leg from Super's number (314) 665-2265 is matched to the answered main-line (601) call it sits inside (leg starts after the call starts and ends no more than 3 seconds after the call ends). If more than one call fits, Super's own log (caller phone + CT time) breaks the tie; otherwise the leg is left unattributed. Legs within one call are collapsed into one transfer attempt; it failed if no person picked up any leg.
